title: FP32 Qwen attention tile measurements

change.candidate: FP32 query-tiled causal GQA attention, enabled only on devices without shader-f16 and with 32-lane subgroups
change.workgroup: 8 token rows and four query heads for one KV head; eight-key K/V tile in FP32 workgroup memory
change.unchanged: The existing FP16 tile and other model paths are unchanged. No projection-fusion experiment is included in the production comparison.
change.candidateBaseRevision: d45755c82b788ab48c8ba0264e20595e59cd7c2d plus the measured Qwen-only worktree changes

result.metric: geometric mean of per-plan median FP32 tiled Kev attention milliseconds

summary.status: Production-source baseline repeats matched the earlier research probes.
summary.strictZeroCheck: Long Kev and SemIf comparisons are nonzero in both baseline and candidate; these results do not isolate attention as the cause. Matmul split or segmentation differences remain hypotheses, not established causes.
summary.semifWarmupTrace: Two initial misses were confirmed in the warmup trace.

sourceProvenance.preliminaryBaseline: The earlier baseline probes came from research server 18111 at 50c4cb0 and remain in raw only as excluded attempts.

validation.recurrenceLanes: All six Qwen baseline/candidate model guard runs selected 16 lanes; the four production Kev/SemIf profiles also selected 16 lanes.
validation.knownFailure: Laya maxDp 0.024006444195624588 remains above its unchanged strict 0.024 limit, as before.
validation.buildsAndTests: 64 Rust tests, 103 JavaScript tests, 77 JavaScript syntax checks, all three WASM validations, site staging, and independent source review passed on the candidate worktree.
validation.pending: CI and Pages verification after PR creation are not included.

exclusions: Earlier root autoresearch chrome-kev-tile-f32* full-model trials are not included in the production table.
Unshipped paired-projection fusion experiments are excluded.
